profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Eric is a native New Yorker. He learned to code in high school and never looked back.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Developed iOS applications for this software consulting agency and it's largest client.

•FreshDirect for iPad - Developed a mobile app shopping experience for a large online grocer in New York. This project won a Webby award for 2015 Best Shopping Tablet App. 
[http://webbyawards.com/winners/2015/mobile-sites-apps/tablets/shopping-tablet-all-other-devices/freshdirect-for-ipad/]

•FoodKick (by FreshDirect) - iPhone App - Led the development of a new app for a new line of business for FreshDirect. FoodKick launched in January 2016. [https://foodkick.freshdirect.com]

•Both applications were written using Xamarin iOS

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description:
Started a risk management and consulting solutions company to provide hedge funds and other asset managers access to great software and risk management services.

•Built Northstar, an advanced real-time risk and profit loss monitoring system.
•Using a custom-built historical returns based risk projection system, app could generate a live view of a portlio's risks with tremedous flexibility.
•Built a marketing website and worked on client development.

positions.title: Vice President | Front Office Development
positions.description:
Architected and developed risk management and market analytics applications for this $6B hedge fund which traded many asset classes, including Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities and FX.

•Built RCPM, a real-time risk and profit loss monitoring system.
•RCPM used historical returns based risk analytics of any grouping of positions in the funds.
•Custom built pricing engines were built to calculate semi-real-time prices for illiquid assets.
•Worked daily with the portfolio managers, research anaylists, risk managers and the heads of the company to collect business requirements as well as provide support for the existing app.
•Built a distributed computing environment to run cash flows and price various fixed income assets (RMBS, CMBS, CLO, etc) through simulation engines reducing the time to process such scenarios from original times of overnight processing to under 1 minute.
•Technologies used include: C#, .Net WinForms, SQL Server, WCF, Sybase.
•Integrated systems include: Bloomberg, Intex, LPS, CoreLogic, Charles River.

positions.title: Risk Management Developer
positions.description:
Developed risk management applications for this $8B+ hedge fund trading in many asset classes.

•Developed RiskViewer, a real-time risk management system.
•RiskViewer used historical returns based risk analysis computed via RiskMetrics, a third party platform.
•Developed new Product Master system, daily reporting emails, and one-off research analysis tools.
•Technologies used include: C# .Net 2.0, WinForms, MS SQL, Infragistics, Subversion, Excel & Outlook VBA.

positions.title: Order Management Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of developers to develop a widely used trading system.

•Developed Lava Trading, a multi asset, global trade order management application.
•Developed screens and functionality of: blotter, order launcher, symbol lookup, market data quote sheet, and configuration window portions of the application.
•Technologies used include: C#, WinForms

positions.title: Order Management Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of developers to contine developement of a heavily used intrernal trading system within the equities division.

•Developed GOMAN, a global order management application
•Worked with equities trading desks to implement new features in this existing large application
•Technologies used include: C#, WinForms, C++, Sybase, Oracle, TIBCO, FIX, NUnit, ClearCase

positions.title: Risk Management Developer
positions.description:
Developed risk management applications for our client, a $2B+ hedge fund trading in many asset classes.

•Developed Risk, a real-time risk and profit loss monitoring system.
•Architected and developed a multi-tier strategy to do risk calclutions in a server environment and publish those results to a local intranet website.
•Technologies used include: C#, ASP.Net, SQL Server
•Integrated systems include: Bloomberg, EzeCastle TC, Advent Axys Accounting, WONDA

positions.title: Risk Management Developer
positions.description:
Developed risk management applications for a $300M+ hedge fund trading equities in the techology sector.

•Developed Retina, a real-time risk and profit loss monitoring system.
•Developed Lens, a fundamental research tool to do equity valuations.
•Developed Iris, a back-office accounting, compliance and reporting tool
•Developed Owenoke.com, a client facing website with a built in CRM
